授.meaning: An old sea captain hands his rusty <part>anchor</part> to the youngest sailor, who must <part>accept</part> it with both hands, though it's heavy. Along with it come fifty years of knots, storms and sea songs. Some things you can only <kanji>impart</kanji> in person.
授.on: A <sound>ju</sound>ry of seagulls watches from the rail and nods.
授.kun: He also hands over a tin of <sound>sa</sound>rdines and a yu<sound>zu</sound> for the long trip.

頼.meaning: A shipwrecked sailor clings to a <part>bundle</part> of driftwood with a <part>rubber duck</part> tied on top as a lookout. The duck squeaks left, he paddles left; it squeaks right, he paddles right. It's never been wrong yet. That duck has his total <kanji>trust</kanji>.
頼.on: It even steers him round a sleeping <sound>rhi</sound>no floating on its back.
頼.kun: He begs the duck for a <sound>ta</sound>co, but it only ties a k<sound>no</sound>t in his beard.

導.meaning: Lost on a foggy <part>road</part>, a hiker meets a ghost who points the way with a <part>golf club</part>: left at the cow, right at the puddle, straight on past the old windmill. He never speaks, he only swings. Still, it's excellent <kanji>guidance</kanji>.
導.on: With each swing, a ball of bread <sound>dough</sound> lands on the right path.
導.kun: A <sound>mee</sound>rkat follows the trail with a lump of <sound>chee</sound>se, and a <sound>bee</sound>tle rides on its back.

迫.meaning: A shy penguin stands at the top of a <part>ramp</part> on a <part>white</part> iceberg, too scared to slide. Her friends push, cheer and wave fish at her: 'Go! Go! Now!' At last she gives in to the <kanji>urge</kanji>.
迫.on: At the bottom she crashes face first into a <sound>huc</sound>kleberry pie.
迫.kun: A red <sound>se</sound>tter barks, and her <sound>ma</sound>ma waddles closer and closer to see.

束.meaning: A greedy <part>tree</part> grows a <part>mouth</part> in its trunk and gulps down every stick that blows past. By autumn it's so stuffed that its branches bulge in all directions, held round the middle by its own bark. It looks like one giant <kanji>bundle</kanji>.
束.on: Out of its mouth pokes one smelly <sound>sock</sound> it swallowed by mistake.
束.kun: A woodcutter ties it up and drags it home to fuel a <sound>ta</sound>co <sound>ba</sound>rbecue.

奇.meaning: A <part>large</part> man stands on the roof of the town hall, giving his <part>approval</part> to everything below: 'Yes' to the pigeons, 'yes' to the rain, 'yes' to a cow wearing a hat. Nobody knows who he is or how he got up there. It's all very <kanji>strange</kanji>.
奇.on: At sunset he unlocks a tiny door in the chimney with a brass <sound>key</sound> and vanishes.
奇.kun: Next morning, a <sound>coo</sound>k finds a <sound>shee</sound>p up there instead, nodding at everything.
